items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-09
items.q: Dear Stuart, thought you'd like a copy of these snaps.

ctx.x: All right. This is the letter. The heading is... No dating on it. Dr. Edmond Sushant. No all names there.

Dear Stuart, thought you'd like a copy of these snaps. Do wish that I could get some together with you and Tom Brown some night soon. And deeply, as it says here, I am deeply regretful that you got away without playing a note last Saturday night, even though you gave me that, quote, I got a new horn and can't blow it yet, unquote. I was not going to let you get away without showing those guys, well, they call you Red Hot. That's underlined from I was not going down through Red Hot. Speak to Tom some night soon…

Well, that'll show you what kind of people that the jazz club has and at the head of it. He wrote me in 1949 that I have proof that we were the original Dixieland jazz band. Now he's writing up on this guy that he is the original Dixieland jazz band. They give him a cup for his presence of being in the jazz club. What wonderful people they have in New Orleans. All they were doing was to start integration, what they call the mixing bowl. They had started that up north 22 years ago, 20 years ago, by Marshall Stein.…
